title: 新老客户净收入及客单价
context: 营销部门比较首购客户与已有购买历史的客户。
requirements: 仅线上有效订单。客户首次有效订单以日期、订单编号决胜；2025年按订单是否首购分组，输出客户数、订单数、净收入和平均订单净额（分）。
commonError: 先筛2025会把已有购买客户误标为新客；客户可在两个组出现。
executionSteps: 计算完整历史订单序号
mysqlSql: WITH a AS (SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_date,order_id) rn FROM v_order_net WHERE channel='online') SELECT CASE WHEN rn=1 THEN 'new' ELSE 'returning' END segment,COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) customers,COUNT(*) orders,SUM(net_cents) net_cents,ROUND(1.0*SUM(net_cents)/COUNT(*),2) avg_order_cents FROM a WHERE order_date BETWEEN '2025-01-01' AND '2025-12-31' GROUP BY CASE WHEN rn=1 THEN 'new' ELSE 'returning' END ORDER BY segment
